subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements is correct regarding five year plan in India?

I. India had emerged as one of the fastest growing economy by the end of the Tenth Five year Plan.

II. Tenth Five year Plan had set 'monitorable targets for few key indicators of development.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Both I and II** statements are correct regarding the Tenth Five Year Plan in India.
 
• India had indeed emerged as one of the fastest-growing economies by the end of the Tenth Five Year Plan.
 
• The Tenth Five Year Plan had set 'monitorable targets' for a few key indicators of development, emphasizing measurable outcomes and accountability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Tenth Five Year Plan spanned from 2002 to 2007 and aimed at achieving an 8% GDP growth rate.
 
• It focused on increasing the growth rate of the economy, reducing poverty, and improving the quality of life through better education, health, and infrastructure.
 
• The plan was designed to prioritize inclusive growth, ensuring that the benefits of economic growth reach the disadvantaged sections of society.
 
• The Tenth Plan also emphasized the importance of good governance and the effective implementation of policies at both central and state levels.
